Set a demographic process specification

Source: R/set_process.R
set_process.Rd

Store a process specification under its name, replacing an existing process with the same name. Other processes are retained. Built-in rate schedules are validated again when attached. No simulation is executed.

Usage

set_process(model, process)

set_mortality(model, rates, group_prop_hazard = NULL)

set_fertility(
  model,
  rates,
  birth_interval = 0.75,
  group_prop_hazard = NULL,
  inheritance = create_group_inheritance(),
  ffab = 0.4886,
  hetfert = NULL
)

Arguments

model

A hammel_model object.

process

A hammel_process specification.

rates

An age-specific rate table passed to mortality() or fertility().

group_prop_hazard

Optional named numeric vector of finite nonnegative rate multipliers by group. Missing groups use 1.0; values are not normalized. Scales shared or group-specific fertility input rates before cell accounting. Without population groups, simulation warns and ignores it. Fertility also accepts a named list of vectors for partnered and/or unpartnered, or cohab/marriage when rates include those union_type strata. List names must occur in the schedules; omitted entries use 1.0.

birth_interval

Minimum maternal birth-to-birth interval in years, defaulting to 0.75. Must be finite and nonnegative.

inheritance

A group identity model from create_group_inheritance(), or a tibble with numeric time_start, time_end and list-column model containing complete inheritance models. Intervals are half-open absolute years, must not overlap and must cover the requested run. Select the active model at each birth; older identities and ancestry remain unchanged. Base data frames with list columns are accepted. All declared possible identities across scheduled models join the simulation-wide registry. Static inputs may also be a method name requiring no additional parameters: "mother", "father", "random_parent", "same_sex", "opposite_sex", or "ancestry". Applies to fertility and defaults to selecting either parent with equal probability, with maternal fallback. Assignment is independent of recorded ancestry proportions.

ffab

Probability that a newborn is female, default 0.4886. Must be a finite numeric scalar in [0, 1]. Applies to fertility only.

hetfert

NULL (default) for uniform mother selection, or a het_fert() specification for persistent lognormal selection weights.

Value

An updated hammel_model. The input model is not modified.

Details

set_mortality() and set_fertility() construct the corresponding process and delegate to set_process().

Examples

mortality_rates <- data.frame(sex = c("m", "f"), age_start = 0,
  age_end = Inf, rate = c(0.01, 0.008))
fertility_rates <- data.frame(age_start = 15, age_end = 50, rate = 0.1)
model <- hammel_model() |>
  set_mortality(mortality_rates) |>
  set_fertility(fertility_rates)
model$processes
